name: New Mexico River Stewardship Program

funder.name: New Mexico Environment Department, Surface Water Quality Bureau

summary: State funding, awarded through requests for proposals, for planning, design and construction of projects that improve surface water quality or river habitat on New Mexico streams and rivers. Nonprofits, businesses, local governments and Tribes can apply.
reporting: Funded projects must submit project reports under NMED's reporting guidance.

status.quote: River Stewardship Program RFP - open March 19th- June 18th, 2026

opens.quote: River Stewardship Program RFP - open March 19th- June 18th, 2026

deadline.quote: River Stewardship Program RFP - open March 19th- June 18th, 2026

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: towns, cities, counties, soil and water conservation districts, irrigation districts, state agencies, non-profit and for-profit organizations, Indian Nations, Pueblos and Tribes.

geography.quote: to enhance the health of New Mexico streams and rivers by improving surface water quality or river habitat

access.quote: Projects are selected through Requests for Proposals (RFP) using the state procurement system.

window.quote: River Stewardship Program RFP - open March 19th- June 18th, 2026

reporting.quote: All funding opportunities provided by NMED SWQB require project reports.
